title: High Tide Helicopters

services.name: Helicopter Tour
services.desc: Looking for a fun and safe activity to do with your family in Southport North Carolina? An airplane tour with High Tide Aviation is a great way to spend time together and see the coast from above. It is easy to book and a fun memory for all ages. Our aerial tours leave from Cape Fear Regional Jetport in Southport NC. Families come from all over the area including Oak Island Bald Head Island and Wilmington to enjoy the view. Many parents ask if aerial tours are safe for kids and older adults. The answer is yes. Our pilots are trained professionals with years of experience. Safety is our number one goal on every flight.
